children: Crypto KOL Kuai Dong said DeepSeek’s investor meeting leaked information again after a new session last Sunday. According to ChainCatcher, the company had previously required attendees to travel to its Beijing or Hangzhou office and hand over their phones, electronic devices, and backpacks before hearing CEO Liang Wenfeng speak, following a leaked internal audio recording in May.

The latest leak came one day after the meeting. An investor source told Information Express that DeepSeek’s current key priority is to use more domestic chips and mentioned the earliest delivery time for Huawei chips.

title: DeepSeek Investor Meeting Leaks Again as Company Prioritizes Domestic Chips
